sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Use én for I, te for you and ő for he/she.

Notice that ő does double duty for both ‘he’ and ‘she’ — Hungarian pronouns carry no gender at all, and that’s true everywhere in the language, not just here. So don’t go hunting for a feminine version of ő later; there isn’t one. Context, not the pronoun, tells you who’s being talked about.
